items.title: Exxon Mobil says floodwater overwhelmed pump at Joliet, Illinois refinery
items.summary: Exxon Mobil reported that floodwater overwhelmed a pump at its 275,000-barrel-per-day refinery in Joliet, Illinois, deploying a containment boom for cleanup. The incident followed a power outage that shut down the refinery, which is a major fuel supplier to the U.S. Midwest, contributing to concerns in a tight global fuel market. The disruption adds to pressure on fuel supplies due to international conflicts and rising diesel prices.

items.title: Popular sees Puerto Rico investment spread across sectors
items.summary: Popular Inc. CEO Jorge J. García noted at the Barclays Global Financial Services Conference that investment in Puerto Rico is diversifying across construction, tourism, logistics, and pharmaceuticals, contributing to a stable economic environment with low unemployment. While acknowledging concerns like high oil prices, García highlighted growth in commercial loans and a healthy credit portfolio, though auto lending faces pressure from rising vehicle costs. He emphasized the importance of diverse investments beyond traditional sectors and the potential for manufacturing expansions to boost both construction and employment.

items.title: A Look Back at Regional Banks Stocks’ Q2 Earnings: Washington Trust Bancorp (NASDAQ:WASH) Vs The Rest Of The Pack
items.summary: This article reviews the Q2 earnings performance of regional banks, with a focus on Washington Trust Bancorp (NASDAQ:WASH). It highlights the mixed results across the sector, noting that while some banks like OFG Bancorp performed well, others such as Banc of California experienced disappointing quarters. The piece also touches on market risks that have shifted from AI concerns to geopolitical tensions and then back to fundamental analysis.

items.title: QUICK SPARK: KKR Raises 10-Year Treasury Yield Forecast To 5.1% As Higher-For-Longer Rates Loom
items.summary: KKR & Co. has revised its forecast for the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield, projecting it to reach 5.1% by the end of the year, up from its previous estimate of 5%. The firm anticipates that the Federal Reserve will maintain elevated interest rates for a longer period, possibly raising them again in December and March, due to persistent inflation and robust economic growth. KKR believes inflation may not return to the Fed's 2% target until 2029, supporting a tighter monetary policy.

items.title: Nova Minerals Corp.: Port MacKenzie Industry Day Highlights Nova Minerals' Antimony Processing and Refining Project as Anchor for Alaska's Critical Minerals Future
items.summary: Nova Minerals Corp. announced that its antimony processing and refining project was a central focus at the Port MacKenzie Industry Day, highlighting its role as an anchor for Alaska's critical minerals future. The project, supported by a US$43.4 million award from the U.S. Department of War, aims to establish a domestic antimony supply chain. Various stakeholders discussed infrastructure improvements at Port MacKenzie to support critical mineral processing and industrial development, with Governor Mike Dunleavy praising Alaska's efforts to strengthen national security and economic future through critical mineral development.

items.title: Freedom Broker downgrades Nucor stock rating on Q3 guidance miss
items.summary: Freedom Broker has downgraded Nucor's stock rating from Buy to Hold and lowered its price target after the company's third-quarter 2026 guidance missed both Freedom Broker's estimates and Street consensus. Despite an impressive stock performance over the past year, Nucor shares fell in pre-market trading following the guidance release. Other analysts, including Barclays, maintain a positive outlook on the steel sector and Nucor, while Jefferies lowered its outlook due to a tentative US-Canada trade agreement reducing steel and aluminum tariffs.

items.title: Adient stock hits 52-week low at $17.67
items.summary: Adient PLC's stock has fallen to a 52-week low of $17.67, representing a 27.94% decline over the past year due to challenges in the automotive seating industry and broader market volatility. Despite recent revenue growth, the company's earnings per share missed expectations, although InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock may be undervalued relative to near-term earnings growth.

items.title: Should You Be Bullish on Tyler Technologies (TYL)?
items.summary: Fenimore Asset Management initiated a new position in Tyler Technologies, Inc. (TYL) in Q2 2026, citing its strong market position as a software provider to state and local governments, high customer retention, and mission-critical solutions despite AI impact fears. The company's stock has seen a 4.10% one-month return but a 37.05% loss over the past 52 weeks, with a market capitalization of $13.99 billion. While Fenimore is bullish, other analysts suggest certain AI stocks might offer greater upside and less risk.
